headline: Nitori breach may expose 37.6M member records; Check Point PHP2Shell and N-central zero-days still exploited

bullets.text: New: Japanese retailer Nitori reports unauthorized access; data on 37.62 million members may have leaked. Also new: hackers stole patient-record data from MKG Bremen, and Louisiana's Acadia Parish School System shut down computers over a suspected cyber incident.
Operation Endgame took down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC servers and seized 6.4 million stolen logins; 179,745 CastleRAT accounts were added to Have I Been Pwned.
PHP2Shell (5 outlets): Check Point zero-day CVE-2026-123039 is exploited for root on gateways; attackers deploy a TSGA backdoor and wipe ESXi files. No fixed release version is on the board.
N-central (PoC, 6 outlets): the N-able '4EverAble2Shell' zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC; 21 servers infected, 19 on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe. No CVE or fix is on the board.

MSPs (8 outlets): worm-like SCKit spreads through ScreenConnect support sessions. Still active: Apify customer data accessed, SilentAir SMS 2FA interception in Asia, SignDrop Windows CLFS zero-day, 4,800 GitHub accounts hijacked, Apache httpd CVE-2026-119618, Fireworks AI breach.

KEV due today (11-13): Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. SITCON 3; last 7 days run 1.09x the 90-day average.

actions: Check Have I Been Pwned for CastleRAT stealer logins on your domains and reset any affected credentials and sessions.
Check Point: apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-123039, limit gateway management to trusted networks, and hunt for TSGA backdoor indicators.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, confirm third-party extensions are disabled, and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions.
Apify users: rotate API tokens and stored secrets; move admin accounts off SMS 2FA to app-based or hardware keys.
Patch Barracuda ESG today (KEV deadline 11-13) and Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618; review GitHub sign-ins, PATs and Actions secrets.
